V1b.note: chain with qualitative view-measurable geometry step (item 3)

hypothesis: H-E2 (this experiment's own, NOT plan H1 which is E3 process-vs-outcome): V1>B2>B1
outcome: H-E2 refuted at pilot scale (n_train=115): B1 71.1% >> V1 37.8% ~ V1b 30.0% ~ B2 34.4% (all 3 reasoning arms indistinguishable)

mechanism.finding: Reasoning arms substitute MEMORIZED template cell-parameters for image reading: V1 emits only 30 distinct geometry strings across 90 generations (one fake 'a=4.002,b=4.002,c=10.005' appears 22x), then reasons correctly from the fabricated numbers. V1 also never learned to terminate the chain (1.1% reach ANSWER line, loops to token cap even at 900 tokens). B1 has no intermediate to fabricate and directly maps visual features to the label.

termination_rate.note: non-termination is a property of the rigid chain form (V1+V1b), not the geometry content

geometry_collapse.note: collapse persists whether geometry is numeric-exact (V1) or qualitative (V1b) -> data-hunger of trace SFT, not ungroundability alone
geometry_collapse.distinct_count_note: RETRACTED as collapse metric for V1b; see geometry_step_accuracy

mechanism.corrected_example: recurring 'a=4.002,b=4.002,c=10.005' is a=b!=c -> model concludes tetragonal (consistent logic on fabricated input); pre-correction text wrongly said 'a=b=c->cubic'

geometry_step_accuracy.metric: per-structure match of emitted relations vs pipeline truth (full-triple ~0.32-0.36 both arms)
geometry_step_accuracy.distinct_count_status: RETRACTED for V1b (low-cardinality qualitative vocab by design)

termination.rediagnosis: MOTIF Wyckoff-enumeration repetition trap (not section looping); each tag emitted once
termination.gold_prefix_probe: V1b emits correct ANSWER 20/20 given gold chain through MOTIF -> answer mapping learned; failure is upstream repetition
termination.eos_in_labels: target EOS supervised (train_e2_lora.py L93-101, prompt masked to -100)

mechanism.revised_failure_locus: NOT primarily geometry-grounding. Dominant failure at pilot scale = a decoding repetition pathology in the variable-length [MOTIF] enumeration that prevents the chain from terminating. Geometry step is separately weak (~35%) but secondary.

caveats: train n=115 structures is small (absolute); E2 is a within-arm comparison, 3 seeds bound noise
test n=30 (some systems thin: monoclinic n=2, tetragonal/trigonal n=3)
V1 re-evaluated at 900 max_new_tokens to rule out truncation; collapse persists (real, not artifact)
plan_branch_note: Observed B1 > both reasoning arms fell OUTSIDE both plan-anticipated E2 branches (V1>B2>B1 or V1~=B2); recorded as a gap in the plan's E2 decision rule.

statistics.interpretation: Only B1's advantage survives n=30 noise (p<0.01 vs each reasoning arm). The 3 reasoning arms are mutually indistinguishable.

v1b_consequence_for_E3.a_qualitative_geometry_reward: score edge/angle/ratio relations, not exact values (V1b confirms views support qualitative only)
v1b_consequence_for_E3.b_fix_MOTIF_step: constrain the open-ended Wyckoff enumeration (fixed slots/dedup/length cap) or explicitly reward termination, else GRPO optimizes a non-terminating policy
v1b_consequence_for_E3.framing: design choices for E3; whether process reward lifts grounding is E3's hypothesis (plan H1), not demonstrated here

status: done (pilot scale, n_train=115; full-scale SFT arm pending). No pre-registered gate at E2.
structural_tilt_note: At n=115, B1 fits a 7-way mapping (4-8 tok target) while chain arms fit ~231-tok generative targets; reasoning-trace SFT is the most data-hungry regime, so the pilot systematically favors B1. Full-scale (50k-150k) is the definitive comparison.
